# Suites excluded from the Linux CI gate.
#
# Every line is a repo-relative path to a `*.test.ts` file that CANNOT pass on Linux for
# ENVIRONMENTAL reasons — not because the code under test is broken. Each entry must carry the
# reason, because an entry without one is indistinguishable from a suite somebody muted to get a
# green check.
#
# This file is the single source of truth for the split. `scripts/ci-linux-suite.ts` reads it to
# build both the gated list and the quarantined list, so the two can never disagree, and it
# REJECTS an entry that no longer names a discovered test file — a renamed or deleted suite cannot
# keep a stale exemption alive.
#
# The quarantine is checked in BOTH directions. CI also runs these files and requires each one to
# still fail: a suite that starts passing on Linux makes its own entry stale, and the job fails
# telling you to delete the line rather than leaving a permanent hole nobody revisits.
#
# Measured 3 of 3 runs each on `main` at 40c37b1 with `bun install --frozen-lockfile`, recorded in
# src/__tests__/helpers/source-assertions.ts. Counts are deliberately NOT asserted anywhere: the
# suite is nondeterministic at the margin, so a count is a flake generator. Only the direction
# (still red / now green) is gated.

# BSD `stat -f` and hardcoded macOS tool paths; the fixture server port also reads NaN here.
src/__tests__/macos-app-lifecycle.test.ts

# Reads a companion artifact layout that only the Darwin build produces.
src/__tests__/native-app-companion-contract.test.ts

# `getDataDir` assumes the checkout is a descendant of HOME, which does not hold on this platform.
src/__tests__/config.test.ts
